intro: **Learn less, master more.** This list is the short version of the whole site: what most product companies actually ask in 2026-27, picked from the research behind the Interview Rounds guide. Finish **Tier 1** before anything else; it covers most of what a typical loop tests. **Tier 2** adds range. Everything not listed here is optional depth. Ticks here are the same as ticks on each item's own page.

groups.title: Your stack, in depth (the resume deep-dive)
groups.description: Interviewers probe the stack on your resume for 45-60 minutes. These are the most-asked questions on Java, Spring Boot, SQL and microservices.

items.title: What are the four pillars of OOP? Explain each with a Java example.
What is the difference between an abstract class and an interface in Java 8+?
Method overloading vs overriding — what are the rules?
Why is String immutable in Java?
How many objects are created by `String s = new String("hello")`? What's the String pool?
String vs StringBuilder vs StringBuffer?
What is the equals() and hashCode() contract? What happens if you override only equals()?
Explain the internal working of HashMap in Java 8.
HashMap vs Hashtable vs ConcurrentHashMap vs synchronizedMap?
How does ConcurrentHashMap work internally in Java 8? Why doesn't it allow null?
ArrayList vs LinkedList — when would you use each?
Fail-fast vs fail-safe iterators? How do you avoid ConcurrentModificationException?
HashSet vs LinkedHashSet vs TreeSet? How does HashSet ensure uniqueness?
How would you implement an LRU cache in Java?
Comparable vs Comparator?
What is Inversion of Control and Dependency Injection?
Constructor vs setter vs field injection — which is recommended and why?
@Component vs @Service vs @Repository vs @Controller vs @Bean?
What are the bean scopes in Spring? Is a singleton bean thread-safe?
What happens when you inject a prototype bean into a singleton bean? How do you fix it?
Explain the Spring bean lifecycle.
How do you resolve 'NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException' when two beans implement the same interface?
What does @SpringBootApplication do?
How does Spring Boot auto-configuration work internally?
How do Spring profiles work? How do you manage configuration across dev, QA and prod?
@Controller vs @RestController? @RequestParam vs @PathVariable?
Explain the request flow in Spring MVC (DispatcherServlet).
How do you implement global exception handling in Spring Boot?
How does validation work in Spring Boot? How do you write a custom validator?
PUT vs PATCH vs POST? What does idempotent mean?
Write a query to find the second highest salary from the Employee table. Return NULL if it doesn't exist.
Write a query to find the Nth highest salary.
Find employees who earn more than their managers. Table: Employee(id, name, salary, manager_id).
Find duplicate emails in a Person(id, email) table, and then delete duplicates keeping the row with the smallest id.
Find customers who never placed an order. Tables: Customers(id, name), Orders(id, customer_id).
Find the top 3 highest-paid employees in each department. Tables: Employee(id, name, salary, dept_id), Department(id, name).
Find the highest-paid employee(s) in each department.
Find numbers that appear at least three times consecutively. Table: Logs(id, num), id is sequential.
Calculate a running total of sales by date, and a running total per customer. Table: Orders(id, customer_id, order_date, amount).
Pivot rows into columns: from Sales(product, quarter, amount) produce one row per product with Q1..Q4 columns.
Find departments with more than 5 employees, and departments whose average salary is above the company average.
Find employees earning more than the average salary of their own department.
Find the cumulative/month-over-month revenue growth percentage. Table: Orders(order_date, amount).
Find users who logged in on at least 3 consecutive days. Table: Logins(user_id, login_date).
Get the latest order for each customer. Table: Orders(id, customer_id, order_date, amount).
What are microservices? What are their advantages and disadvantages compared to a monolith?
How would you decompose a monolith into microservices?
What is the database-per-service pattern? How do you handle queries that need data from multiple services?
What is service discovery? Client-side vs server-side discovery?
What is an API Gateway and why is it needed? What's the difference from a load balancer?
REST vs messaging (Kafka) for inter-service communication — how do you choose?
What is Feign client? How do you configure timeouts and error handling?
Explain Kafka architecture: topics, partitions, consumer groups and offsets.
How does Kafka guarantee message ordering? What happens if you need global ordering?
What delivery semantics does Kafka offer? How do you avoid duplicate processing?
Kafka vs RabbitMQ?
What is the circuit breaker pattern? Explain its states.
What are retry, bulkhead and rate limiter patterns? How do they work together?
How do you handle distributed transactions in microservices?
Explain the Saga pattern: choreography vs orchestration with an e-commerce example.
